import json
prog = currentProgram
out = {"sha256": str(prog.getExecutableSHA256())}
addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x140a38460")
fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
f = fm.getFunctionAt(addr)
out["tag"] = "TreeStorage_get"
if f is None:
    raise RuntimeError("function absent at 0x140a38460")
out["name"] = str(f.getName())
out["entry"] = str(f.getEntryPoint())
out["size"] = str(f.getBody())
out["signature"] = str(f.getSignature())
it = prog.getListing().getInstructions(f.getBody(), True)
insns = []
while it.hasNext():
    monitor.checkCancelled()
    ins = it.next()
    ops = []
    for i in range(ins.getNumOperands()):
        r = ins.getDefaultOperandRepresentation(i)
        ops.append(r if r is not None else "")
    raw = ins.getBytes()
    hexb = "".join("%02x" % (b & 0xFF) for b in raw)
    insns.append([str(ins.getAddress()), ins.getMnemonicString(), ops, hexb])
out["insns"] = insns
print(json.dumps(out))
